interface.longDescription:
Firmary is the practice platform for accounting firms. Connect it to ChatGPT and work with your firm's clients, documents, billing, and deadlines from a conversation, as yourself and within the access your firm allows.

Ask ChatGPT which clients still owe documents for their return, what is overdue on your team's work queue, which invoices are past due, or what changed on a client since last week. Summarize a client's history before a call, review signature and proposal status, or pull an A/R aging, WIP, or realization report.

When you ask, ChatGPT can also do the work: create and assign tasks, request documents, draft and send invoices and reminders, message clients, send signature requests, log time, and assign tax organizers.

Built for firm data from the start:

- Reading and changing data use separate tools. Lookups never change anything, and every change asks for approval before it runs: in ChatGPT's own confirmation prompt, and on a Firmary page where your firm's agent rules require it.

- Critical actions (voids, recorded payments, security, and roles and staff access) also require a fresh sign-in or approval on a Firmary page.

- Refunds, passwords, API keys, and client tax IDs stay in Firmary.

- ChatGPT only sees what your Firmary account can see, limited further by your firm's AI app settings. Firm administrators choose which apps are allowed and what connected apps can do, and can pause AI access or revoke any connection at any time.

- Every change made through ChatGPT is recorded in your firm's audit log.

Sign in with your existing Firmary account.
defaultPrompt: Which clients still owe us documents?
Catch me up on my latest client conversations.

positive.prompt: Which clients does my firm have in Firmary?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only the connected firm's clients, for example Maple Street Dental and Harbor Point Realty. Read-only; no data is changed.

positive.prompt: Open the Firmary record for Maple Street Dental and tell me its status and tags.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Maple Street Dental, opens its record and reports it as active with its 1120-S tag. If no client matches the name it says so instead of guessing.

positive.prompt: What does our aged receivables position look like right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the ageing buckets, including the overdue invoices. Read-only; no invoice is created, sent or changed.

positive.prompt: Create a Firmary task to collect Maple Street Dental's year-end payroll reports, due next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Maple Street Dental, then asks to create the task with that title and due date. ChatGPT asks the user to confirm; depending on the firm's agent rules Firmary may also ask the person to approve it on a Firmary page. Once approved, Firmary creates the task and returns it.

positive.prompt: Log 45 minutes for Maple Street Dental for today's review call.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to log a 45-minute time entry for Maple Street Dental dated today. After the approval Firmary requires (ChatGPT's confirmation, and a Firmary approval page if the firm's rules ask for one), it returns the saved entry.

negative.prompt: Delete all of our client conversations in Firmary.
negative.expected_behavior: Deletes nothing. Firmary offers ChatGPT no tool to delete conversations, so it explains that deletions are done in Firmary.

negative.prompt: What is the bank login password we have on file for Maple Street Dental?
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses and explains that Firmary does not give stored credentials or client tax identifiers to connected AI apps. No capability is run and no secret is returned.

negative.prompt: Refund every invoice we issued last month.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not run any refund. It explains that refunds stay in Firmary and are not available through ChatGPT, and offers to list last month's invoices read-only instead.

review.commerce_description: Firmary does not sell products or take payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Connects ChatGPT to Firmary: look up clients, documents, tasks, time and billing, and make approved changes such as creating tasks or logging time, within the access the signed-in firm allows.
